Message.Name: Order Addition Message
Message.Description: The moment an order is being accepted by the BMV central system; this message is diffused to the corresponding media.

Field.Name: Instrument number
Field.Description: Unique code during instruments life

Field.Name: Date and Time
Field.Description: Date and time for the addition of order

Field.Name: Number
Field.Description: Assigned number to the order when registered

Field.Name: Direction
Field.Description: C - Buy V - Sell

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Order volume

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Order price

Field.Name: Participant
Field.Description: Short key of participant

Message.Name: Execution of Orders Message
Message.Description: The message is disseminated at the time there is a matching or closing in BMV’s electronic system.

Field.Name: Instrument number
Field.Description: Unique code during instruments life

Field.Name: Date
Field.Description: Date for the addition of order

Field.Name: Number
Field.Description: Number allocated to the order when registered

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Order volume

Field.Name: Trade Number
Field.Description: Trade number with which the order was executed.

Field.Name: Execution price
Field.Description: Price with which the trade was made.

Message.Name: Order Cancellation Message
Message.Description: This message fully eliminates the order from the trading floor.

Field.Name: Instrument number
Field.Description: Unique code during instruments life

Field.Name: Date
Field.Description: Date when the order was registered

Field.Name: Number
Field.Description: Number allocated to the order when registered

Message.Name: Order change Message
Message.Description: Message sent when the order changes one of its data, the system allocates to it a new priority in the electronic book, the order to be replaced is identified with the original Instrument, Date and Number, the new allocation of priority in the electronic book appears in the New Date and Number fields.

Field.Name: Instrument number
Field.Description: Unique code during instruments life

Field.Name: Original date
Field.Description: Date and time when the order was registered

Field.Name: Original number
Field.Description: Number originally allocated to the order

Field.Name: New date
Field.Description: New Date and time when the order was registered (Document label: Original date)

Field.Name: New number
Field.Description: Number allocated to the new order

Field.Name: Direction
Field.Description: C - Buy V - Sell

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Order volume

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price of order
